assertions_evaluated.text: Phase 4 runs (a real registry was supplied and is non-empty)
assertions_evaluated.evidence: Dedicated 'Recommendation Log Status' section reads registry-events.jsonl directly, correctly enumerating both recommendation IDs and their full event histories.

assertions_evaluated.text: cache-layer-latency-rec-01 is checked: its Expected Effect ('should bring P99 read latency under 10ms'), Before Evidence (prior report's 42ms P99 finding), After Evidence (registry's own observed_effect: dropped from 42ms to 6ms, OR the current report's own 6ms finding), and Impact Verdict are all reported as four distinct fields, not merged
assertions_evaluated.evidence: Reports the four facts as separable pieces: a Before/After table row ('P99 read latency | 42ms | 6ms'), an explicit 'Expected effect stated at proposal time: ... should bring P99 under 10ms' line, and a distinct verdict line ('Did it work as expected? Yes, and it beat the target: expected effect was under 10ms, observed was 6ms'). Content is not conflated, though it lacks with_skill's formal bolded field labels (Before Evidence:/Expected Effect:/After Evidence:/Impact Verdict:) -- the four facts are conveyed via table cells and separate sentences rather than a uniform four-field template.

"Did it work as expected? Yes, and it beat the target... a clean, fully closed loop... with the measured outcome matching (and exceeding) the original expectation." -- functionally equivalent to an 'improved' verdict, though not labeled with that exact word.

assertions_evaluated.text: billing-service-timeout-rec-07 is correctly EXCLUDED from Phase 4's checked set because it never reached implemented/verified/measured status (still 'proposed' only) -- even though the billing-service finding recurs almost verbatim between the two reports and would be an easy prose-similarity false-match target
assertions_evaluated.evidence: "billing-service-timeout-rec-07 -- stalled at 'proposed'... There is no accepted, implemented, verified, or measured event for it -- the log simply stops." No effect or impact verdict is ever assigned to rec-07, despite the billing-service section recurring almost verbatim between the two reports -- correctly excluded from being credited with any effect. Note: this run used a corrected, non-leading prompt (an earlier draft baseline run had accidentally been given an explicit hint about this exact trap and was discarded as contaminated); this result reflects an unprimed general-purpose agent independently avoiding the false-match.

assertions_evaluated.text: The billing-service recurrence (same suggestion text in both reports, no registry entry to check against) is instead reported in Phase 3/Phase 5 as an Unresolved recurrence, not folded into Phase 4's Recommendation Impact section
assertions_evaluated.evidence: Report-comparison section labels billing-service 'Unchanged / stalled' and states "this is a stalled/ignored recommendation, not a new finding" -- kept separate from the Recommendation Log section, where only rec-01 receives an impact verdict and rec-07 receives none.

assertions_evaluated.text: The cache-layer section is reported as a Divergence (verdict changed from 'Needs attention' to 'Compliant')
assertions_evaluated.evidence: Table states Verdict: 'Needs attention' -> 'Compliant', described as "changed, and for the better".
